units.desc: This modern 431 sq. ft. unit offers a bright, open-concept living space with wood-style flooring and room to relax or entertain. The comfortable bedroom area fits full-size furnishings and connects to a spacious walk-in closet for easy organization. A contemporary bathroom with a full tub/shower provides comfort and safety, while the convenient kitchenette adds everyday functionality. It’s a well-designed, inviting home within The Pointe at Kirby Gate.

This modern 298 sq. ft. studio offers a bright, open-concept living space with stylish wood-style flooring and a flexible layout designed for both comfort and ease. The thoughtfully arranged sleeping area accommodates full-size furnishings and flows naturally into the cozy living nook, creating a warm, inviting environment. A well-organized closet provides convenient storage, while the contemporary bathroom—with its full tub/shower and sleek finishes—delivers comfort and safety. The efficient kitchenette adds everyday practicality without sacrificing space. It’s a smartly designed, welcoming home within The Pointe at Kirby Gate.

This modern 373 sq. ft. unit offers a bright, open layout with warm wood-style flooring and a comfortable flow between living, sleeping, and dining spaces. The bedroom area easily accommodates full-size furnishings and connects to an oversized closet for organized, accessible storage. A welcoming living nook provides ample room for relaxing or hosting visitors, while the contemporary bathroom features a full tub/shower and sleek finishes for comfort and safety. The efficient kitchenette adds everyday convenience without sacrificing space. It’s a thoughtfully designed, inviting home within The Pointe at Kirby Gate.
